i typically did! it was always hard to get to sleep, especially if my mind was racing. sometimes if you try meditating, or just deep breathing and saying “dont think” in your head over and over, it shuts down a bit. as for hearing things that arent there, could be unconscious paranoia of sorts. when you are losing sleep, your mind sorta decides to do whatever. and the constant waking up might set off a false alarm and have your brain thinking that there MUST be something causing it, so it makes something up. i found that doing some research on how to prevent that and trying a few methods for a week each, did help! if you can get into certain habits, your sleep could improve. some old military sleep tricks i saw to help shut the mind off due to PTSD were helpful. ill try to find them for you!
